# Wave summary

Counts the participants in each wave. Invented for the test suite.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)

# Counts the participants in one wave.
wave_size <- function(enrollments, wave) {
  nrow(dplyr::filter(enrollments, wave_id == wave))
}
```

The same count, written in Python for comparison.

```{python}
def wave_size(enrollments, wave):
    """Counts the participants in one wave."""
    return len([row for row in enrollments if row["wave_id"] == wave])
```
